description: This file defines the core service for an AI-powered React-based agent, including tool setup, message processing, action execution, and exception handling. It implements a class 'AgentService' which manages the agent's interaction loop and utilises several tools for file I/O, date/time, and calculations.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling agent-specific errors with various error types.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main class implementing the AI agent's core loop, managing tools, message flow, and execution logic.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Starts the agent loop, processing user input, and executing steps until a final answer is generated or an error occurs.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Adds a new step to the agent's sequence, updating listeners.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes the set of available tools for the agent, such as file read/write and time calculation.

methods.name: _evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a mathematical expression string, supporting basic operations.

methods.name: _tokenize
methods.description: Converts an expression string into tokens for parsing.

methods.name: _pE
methods.description: Parses addition and subtraction in the expression tokens.

methods.name: _pT
methods.description: Parses multiplication and division in the expression tokens.

methods.name: _pF
methods.description: Parses factors in the expression, handling parentheses and unary minus.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Parses and executes a tool action based on the provided string.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Parses comma-separated arguments from an action string, supporting quoted strings.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content enclosed within specific XML tags.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Creates the initial system prompt detailing tools and instructions for the agent.
